answer.rationale: memory_57 is strongest because it directly reports qualified revenue gains in established customers with no measurable retention harm, supporting sustainability. memory_44 and memory_73 directly address revenue outcomes, though they omit longer-term retention, margin, and cohort durability details. memory_31 and memory_86 show durable or adoption-related leading indicators but do not establish qualified revenue impact. memory_91 is least supported because it reports only week-one engagement and first meaningful action, with no evidence of conversion, revenue quality, retention, or longer-term durability.
